evidence.quoted_text:
require(payload["cli"]["rc"] not in (0, None),
            "interrupted recovery unexpectedly returned success")
evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, recover_kill_phase still asserts only that the CLI return code is nonzero/not None. A normal recover failure before the drain hook, such as a lock or precondition refusal, can also return nonzero while leaving the pending/drained record unchanged, so the later record checks pass and the case falsely reports an interrupted recovery without proving SIGKILL. The kill="drain" case needs rc == -9, and the recover-kill runner predicate needs the same exact-signal check.
